description: Claude Code settings for 3body project - Optimized Agentic Architecture (WP + Diagram Agents)

Write.description: Auto-format Python files and validate diagrams
Write.command: if [[ {file} == src/python/*.py ]]; then black '{file}' && flake8 '{file}'; elif [[ {file} == diagrams/*/*.mmd ]]; then python scripts/validate_diagram.py '{file}'; fi

Edit.description: Auto-format and lint Python files after editing
Edit.command: if [[ {file} == src/python/*.py ]]; then black '{file}' && flake8 '{file}'; fi

preCommit.description: Run fast test suite before git commit
preCommit.command: ./scripts/run_tests.sh --fast || echo 'Note: Fast tests not yet implemented, skipping'

beforeTaskCompletion.description: Verify Flight Recorder exists for research tasks
beforeTaskCompletion.command: if [[ -d 'discovery_logs' || -d 'validation_reports' ]]; then test -f session_log.md || (echo 'WARNING: session_log.md missing for research task' && exit 0); fi
